name: ws2812b
title: Worldsemi WS2812B

ways.do: data to its GPIO, DOUT of the last one on to the next strip

notes: One RGB LED with its driver in the package, chained on one data line. Its price here is by the piece, for the worth of one on a board that nobody asked for.

lcsc.source: C114586, WS2812B-B/W: search results of lcsc.com gave 0.047 to 0.099 for 5 to 1000 pieces; the high end is taken for the least quantity and the low for the largest, as the tiers of LCSC go down. The live page gives no table to a fetch.

lcsc_1000.source: C114586, WS2812B-B/W: search results of lcsc.com gave 0.047 to 0.099 for 5 to 1000 pieces; the high end is taken for the least quantity and the low for the largest, as the tiers of LCSC go down. The live page gives no table to a fetch.

datasheet.source: Worldsemi WS2812B datasheet, Chinese, the copy of LCSC (atta.szlcsc.com, 1499049112282.pdf, sha256 9aca0cff...): 20 mA each of red, green and blue; VIH 0.7 VDD at VDD 4.5 to 5.5 V, so 3.5 V at 5 V; VDD 3.5 to 5.3 V

garland.source: The garland of ~/git/led_strip: 360 WS2812B on two strips, the data line straight from GPIO 14 of an ESP32, the strips fed with 5 V of their own

price.source: search results of lcsc.com, not the live page
